text: Bringing NASDAQ-listed stocks on-chain removes the need to mint intermediary virtual representations of off-chain equities, because tokenized stocks are natively verifiable on blockchain ledgers, which reduces legal and operational friction.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
abstract: By bringing NASDAQ-listed stocks on-chain, the need to mint intermediary virtual representations of off-chain equities as an accounting measure is eliminated. NASDAQ tokenized stocks are natively verifiable on blockchain ledgers. This is key as it reduces legal and operational friction.
